# ECU Lab Copilot instructions

Read `LAW.md`, `COPILOT.md`, `coordination/CURRENT_STATE.md` and your `.handoff/ticket.json` before editing. Follow the shared claim/lease/review protocol. The primary application is C++20 with a native Qt desktop client; the web dashboard is optional. Preserve the existing C++ protocols, timing, project hashes and tests. Do not change core interfaces or another provider's files outside the ticket. A VS Code extension is a manual participant unless a separate CLI adapter is explicitly configured.
